_note: Batches: several groups of jobs in one file, each with its own settings (the UI shows each batch as a tab). The top-level `defaults` apply to every batch; a batch's `defaults` are laid over them; a job's own value wins. Images go to outputs/<output>/<batch name>/<model>/, so this file makes 2 + 2 + 2 = 6 images in outputs/two-looks/photo/zimage/ and outputs/two-looks/anime/illustrious/. Put `skip: true` on a batch to keep it without rendering it.
